Laurieton Lakeside Aged Care Residence is seeking Registered Nurses to join our clinical team today.
Applicants must be committed to quality, safety, be resident focused and have a great attitude.

Position Description
- Registered Nurses at Laurieton Lakeside are responsible for the following duties and tasks (not limited to):
- Assessment and care planning.
- Resident case conferences and family consultations.
- Monthly care statements.
- Administration of medications.
- Monitoring of resident deterioration and escalation pathways.
- Oversight of assistant nursing team, including leadership and delegation.
- Doctor's and Nurse Practicioner rounds.
- Completion of mandatory training and education.
- Attendence and contribution to staff meetings.
- Adherence to facility policies and process, Strengthened Aged Care Standards and the Act Care Act.

Rostered Days/Hours
- Fri to Tue Roster
- AM shifts (0630-1445)

Salary Range
- $85,000 - $120,000

Skills and Experience Required
- Current Practicing Registration as a Registered Nurse with AHPRA.
- Must have current Police Check (Nationally recognised check).
- Experience in aged care essential.
- Knowledge of regulations and AN-ACC funding highly regarded.
- Passion for delivering quality care.
- Excellent time management skills.

How are our RNs supported?
- Clinical management team includes DON, Clinical Managers, Clinical Coordinator and Clinical Educator.
- Onsite pharmacist 3 days per week to support registered staff, conduct resident medication reviews, consult with GPs about medications and speak with residents and families about medications.
- We have an onsite physiotherapist, occupational therapist and physio assistant as part of the allied health team – these staff are employees (not contractors).
- Strong GP relationships with Your Family Practice in Lakewood.
- Nurse Practitioner to support RNs and GPs.
- Experienced FM provides operational support, including workforce management, system improvements and IT/information management (for clinical software).
- AINs are led by an experienced AIN Team Leader.
- Lakeside uses digital systems for resident data management including care planning and assessments, incident reporting, medication management and S8 drug registers.

The Laurieton Lakeside Difference
- We provide our local community with a caring and compassionate aged care service.
- Resident quality of life is our priority.
- We provide holistic care: emotional, physical, mental and spiritual support.
- The home is a friendly, safe environment for residents, families and staff.
- Continuous improvement and learning is encouraged for all staff.
- We maintain lasting relationships with other senior and community based organisations in the Mid North Coast areas.

Interested in this role? Excellent.
Please upload resume and if you are shortlisted, our team will be in touch.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

About the role
We are looking for a special kind of person - a St Vincent's kind of person. Someone who puts compassion, connection and caring for other people at the heart of everything they do. 
 

We have an exciting new opportunity for a Living Support Manager (Care Manager) to join our dynamic team at St Vincent's Care Toowoomba. In this role you will report directly to the Residential Care Services Manager and will be a member the Senior Leadership Team comprising Residential Care Services Manager, Living Support Manager, Clinical Manager, and Hospitality Services Manager. The Living Support Manager leads the team that designs and delivers all Daily Living Activities and Support Services across the household. This team provides, personal care, cooking, lifestyle activities, serving of food, cleaning, laundry, transport, pastoral care and companionship. They contribute to and lead St Vincent's Care Services as a person centric culture that maintains that people are at the centre of all that we do. The Living Support Manager leads and supervises Living Support team members, Hotel Services team, and contractors and ensures all services and work is in line with legislative and industry compliance and standards 
 

What's on your CV is important, but what's in your heart matters more. 

Because at St Vincent's, kindness works for us. 

 
Things that work for you: 

Competitive salary packaging options up to $15,990, Novated leasing, plus an optional Meals and Entertainment card up to $2,650 per annum

Opportunity to work for the nation's largest Catholic not-for-profit health and aged care provider, with a rapidly growing and progressive vision

Career development, mentoring and leadership opportunities within St Vincent's network

Friendly team environment with a great community care spirit

Ability to visibly see your impact on the business and its service

No cost uniforms and training

No mandatory COVID vaccinations! Free annual flu vaccination

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for staff and their families

Access to the Fitness Passport (FP) 

Things that work for us: 

Availability to work full time, Monday to Friday 0800-1606 

Minimum education requirement is Diploma or Certificate IV in Individual Support (CHC33015) or a Cert IV in a similar field or relevant experience. Qualifications in management, business or health management highly regarded 

Previous leadership experience in an aged care home

Uphold the philosophy of person-directed care within home

Facilitate and monitor that the Living Support team members and all other Support Services team members know each resident in their care, understand what each person can do and what assistance they want and how they prefer to be assisted, to meet the personal care, comfort, hygiene and dignity of residents

Recruit, monitor, develop and support appropriately skilled staff and volunteers ensuring that the values and goals of St Vincent's Care are reflected and practiced

Engage with consumers, families, carers, and advocate to promote and support residents wellbeing and independence by encouraging and supporting people to identify, access and engage in their preferred activities and interests

Monitor that Care Plans are developed in partnership with the resident or their representative and that required information is shared in an appropriate, efficient and timely way

Provide leadership and support in the delivery of daily living and personal care to residents in line with SVCS's Mission, Vision and Values and the SCVS Integrated Service Delivery

Maintain knowledge of and monitor compliance at all times with the requirements of the Aged Care Quality Standards 

Why become part of the St Vincent's Care family? 

Because you're like us, you believe that every act of kindness makes the world a better place. Better for everyone who lives in the 20+ facilities and locations we operate in Queensland, New South Wales and Victoria. Better for all our staff and employees, who work tirelessly to provide the highest levels of care and quality of life for our clients. And better support for the local communities we play an important role in and continue to support. 

For more than 175 years, St Vincent's Care Services (SVCS) has been a leading Catholic provider of Aged Care Services in Australia and the legacy of compassion, justice, integrity and excellence entrusted to us by the Sisters of Charity and their Founder Mary Aitkenhead continues to inspire our work today. 

Our spiritual and hospital-based heritage has taught us that wellness is about more than medical needs. It's about building a true partnership around trust and respect. That's why we take a person-centred approach - delivering holistic, individual care that achieves wellbeing for mind, body and spirit. 

At St Vincent's we value inclusivity and diversity and acknowledge the important of creating a work environment that is welcome, safe, fair and impartial and invite people from all backgrounds to join our caring family. 

Reconciliation Action Plan 

St Vincent's Health Australia embraces Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people's unique perspectives, knowledge, and cultural. We strive to achieve better physical, mental, and spiritual health outcomes through continued connection with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities. We understand the need to effectively engage with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities to influence decision making at all levels and to create opportunity through sustainable and culturally safe employment. 

As part of our Commitment to Reconciliation and Closing the Gap in employment related outcomes, we encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples. For further information, visit http:--www.svha.org.au-about-us-reconciliation

Full-time Broker Group Information Management Coordinator position available in Cranbourne West VIC 3977

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Salary Range: $95,000 $105,000 per annum (exclusive superannuation)
•	Position based in Cranbourne West VIC 3977
•	Opportunity to contribute to the growth, structure and efficiency of a national broker network

Position Overview
finweb operates in the Australian mortgage broking and finance services sector as a broker group supporting mortgage brokers across Australia.

The business provides brokers with access to operational support, onboarding assistance, mentoring, business development resources, compliance coordination, in-house processing support, referral opportunities, CRM systems, workflow tools and practical business resources to help them manage and grow their broker businesses.

finweb is seeking a full-time Broker Group Information Management Coordinator to support the business by managing, analysing and reporting on operational information across broker onboarding, broker/member activity, referral pathways, CRM records, workflow systems, processing support, compliance-related administration and business development initiatives. The successful candidate will assist management by ensuring that operational information is accurately recorded, analysed, reported and used to support business decision-making, workflow efficiency, broker support visibility and organisational growth.

Position Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Analyse broker group operational information, including broker onboarding, CRM activity, referral pathways, workflow progress and processing support activity, to identify trends, delays, risks and improvement opportunities.
•	Maintain accurate business information across CRM systems, MyCRM, Trello, spreadsheets, onboarding trackers, broker registers and internal workflow tools.
•	Prepare operational reports, broker activity summaries, onboarding updates, referral reports, pipeline reports and management insights to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Monitor broker onboarding, accreditation, system access, referral tracking and internal workflow processes to identify stalled matters, missing information, handover issues and operational bottlenecks.
•	Develop and maintain reporting tools, workflow templates, onboarding trackers, broker support registers, checklists, process documents and information management procedures.
•	Review internal systems and workflow records to improve data accuracy, reporting structure, CRM visibility, handover quality and operational efficiency.
•	Support management with business information analysis relating to broker/member operations, referral performance, compliance administration, processing support activity and broker group growth initiatives.
•	Conduct research into mortgage broking market trends, broker group service offerings, aggregator support models, competitor positioning, broker recruitment activity and broker support practices to support business planning and operational development.
•	Maintain structured internal business information resources, including lender information, referral partner information, training materials, compliance resources, processing documentation and onboarding materials, to ensure business information remains accurate, accessible and consistently recorded.
•	Document, track and report broker communications, internal updates and operational information to ensure matters are properly recorded, monitored and escalated where appropriate.
•	Support the implementation of improved reporting, workflow tracking and information management practices across broker onboarding, broker support, processing assistance, referral tracking and member engagement.
•	Ensure all information management, broker communication and operational support activities remain within approved business, licensing and compliance boundaries, with credit advice, legal, licensing, commercial or complex matters escalated to appropriately authorised personnel.

Qualifications and Skills:

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES  
Administration & Office Support 
Answer telephone calls, respond to emails, and manage general enquiries in a professional and 
culturally respectful manner. 
 
Perform general administrative duties including scanning, photocopying, filing, and document 
management.  

Maintain accurate client records, databases, and filing systems in accordance with organisational 
policies and privacy requirements
.  
Assist with data entry, reporting, and documentation for CHSP, HCP, NDIS, and other funded 
programs.  

Support roster updates, staff schedule changes, and communication of roster amendments. 
 
Administration Support Officer - Mala’la Aged Care 
 
Client Transport & Appointment Coordination 

Coordinate daily transport schedules including pick-up and drop-off arrangements for Social 
Support at Home (S@H), CHSP, NDIS, and Day Respite clients.  

Work closely with visiting health services, including Mala’la Clinic, Patient Travel, and Chronic 
Conditions teams to support client attendance at medical appointments.  

Liaise with clients, families, support workers, and service providers regarding transport and 
appointment schedules. 
 
Client Support Assistance 
Assist clients with Centrelink residency enquiries, banking enquiries, and access to community 
services.  
Support clients with activating SIM cards, mobile phone setup, and communication with family 
members when required.  
Provide culturally appropriate support to clients in accessing information and services.  
Assist clients in a respectful and confidential manner while maintaining professional boundaries. 
 
Operational Support 
Provide assistance to Support Workers on the floor when required, including:  
Assisting with meal distribution  
Supporting client activities and group programs  
Assisting during busy operational periods
